Analyze the patients listed in {!$Input:PatientInfo}. Review their Care Plan documents and IoT data provided in {!$EinsteinSearch:Default_PatientInfoSheetDMO_Retriever_1Cx_o3Z20b36217.results}. Thoroughly compare each patient's Care Plan targets against their incoming IoT readings. If the patient's readings meet the Care Plan targets, do not display any information. Only output for patients where discrepancies exist between Care Plan goals and IoT data. For each such patient, provide: Patient ID Patient Summary (brief) Description of the discrepancy Analysis of why Care Plan targets were not met Focus only on patients where care goals were not achieved. Ignore patients who are stable and meeting targets.
